wholePhysicalScope: The two named cooling towers, four reactor buildings and visible ancillary structures follow individual native mapped plans. The exterior represents the documented standing arrangement on the west bank of the Scheldt.
lodDetails: All four detail levels preserve the two open cooling towers, four reactor domes and main industrial halls. Closer levels resolve the shell profile, paired tower supports, rims, and ancillary building facades.
limitations: Standing industrial exterior with the twin natural-draft cooling towers, reactor hall massing and adjacent industrial halls. Machinery inside the plant, operational state and steam plumes are outside the model scope.
The native plans and mapped tower heights set the scale. Exact shell thickness, tower staining, support spacing, dome sections, roof equipment and secondary facade details are visual estimates.

The preserved composite elevation field retains its shore relief and local surface artifacts. Foundations transition into this field. The world placement follows its normal terrain provider, with fine grade approximate.
